title: Present Continuous
inst: Complete the sentences in Present Continuous and correct the mistakes.
theory:
Present Continuous - Affirmative & Negative

  • Affirmative (+): Subject + am / is / are + Verb with -ing (e.g., I am sleeping. He is sleeping. They are sleeping.)
  • Negative (-): Subject + 'm not / isn't / aren't + Verb with -ing (e.g., I'm not sleeping. She isn't sleeping. We aren't sleeping.)

Spelling Rules for -ing:

  • Most verbs: wear → wearing, help → helping.
  • Verbs ending in -e (delete the -e): make → making, dance → dancing.
  • One-syllable verbs with consonant-vowel-consonant (double the final letter): run → running, stop → stopping.

items.q: 1. Ray ___ (wear) a warm jacket today. (+)
2. Hop and Bee ___ (not wait) for the bus. (-)
3. We ___ (prepare) our clothes for school. (+)
items.why: Use 'are' for we/you/they and delete the -e in prepare.

items.q: 4. Look! The boy ___ (run) in the race. (+)
items.why: Double the consonant for short C-V-C verbs (run -> running).

items.q: 5. I ___ (not sleep) right now because I am awake. (-)
6. She ___ (make) a dress out of paper. (+)
7. Correct the mistake: She wearing a blue hoodie today.
items.why: Remember to include the verb to be.
a: She is wearing a blue hoodie today.
She's wearing a blue hoodie today.

items.q: 8. Correct the mistake: They isn't running together.
9. Correct the mistake: We are makeing clothes from plastic.
a: We are making clothes from plastic.

items.q: 10. Correct the mistake: I aren't doing my English homework.
a: I am not doing my English homework.
I'm not doing my English homework.

title: Questions, Short Answers & Reasons
inst: Write questions and short answers. Then, choose the correct reason.
theory:
Questions & Short Answers

  • Put Am / Is / Are before the person to make a question.
  • Is she running? Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
  • Are they running? Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

"Why...?" and "Because..."

  • Why asks for a reason (question).
  • Because gives the reason (answer).
  • Example: Why are you running? Because I'm late!

items.q: 1. Write the question AND short answer (Negative): Sarah and Oliver / wear / jeans?
items.why: Use 'Are' for plural subjects. Answer with 'they'.
a: Are Sarah and Oliver wearing jeans? No, they aren't.
Are Sarah and Oliver wearing jeans? No, they are not.

items.q: 2. Write the question AND short answer (Negative): Dad / watch / TV?
items.why: Use 'Is' for singular subjects. Answer with 'he'.
a: Is Dad watching TV? No, he isn't.
Is Dad watching TV? No, he is not.

items.q: 3. Write the question AND short answer (Affirmative): Sarah / read / a book?
items.why: Use 'Is' for singular subjects. Answer with 'she'.
a: Is Sarah reading a book? Yes, she is.

items.q: 4. Write the question AND short answer (Negative): The cat / sleep / on the chair?
items.why: Use 'Is' for singular subjects. Answer with 'it'.
a: Is the cat sleeping on the chair? No, it isn't.
Is the cat sleeping on the chair? No, it is not.

items.q: 5. Why are you wearing pajamas?
o: Because I am going to bed.
items.a: Because I am going to bed.

items.q: 6. Why are you making a cake?
o: Because I am going to bed.

items.q: 7. ___ are you running so fast?
items.why: Use the question word for asking a reason.

items.q: 8. ___ I am late for my class!
items.why: Use the word to give a reason.

title: Shopping For Clothes & Vocabulary
inst: Complete the shopping dialogue and the vocabulary definitions.
theory:
Shopping Vocabulary:

  • Shop Assistant: Can I help you? / What size are you? (Small, Medium, Large) / How are you paying? (With cash / by card)
  • Customer: I'm looking for... / Can I try it on? / How much is it? / I'll take it.

items.q: 1. Shop Assistant: Good morning! ___ (Customer: Yes, please. I am looking for some black trousers).
items.why: This is how a shop assistant greets a customer.

items.q: 2. Shop Assistant: ___? (Customer: I'm a medium.)
